epics.name: E02 - Nền tảng multisite giai đoạn 1

epics.name: E06 - Thư viện layout preset

epics.name: E07 - Nền tảng sản phẩm tour WingsGo

epics.name: E08 - Nâng cấp inbound WingsSide

US-046A.proofStatusNote: Implemented and production-accepted in WP5 on 2026-07-23. Typed Payload hi-fi contract, validated route model, governed Plan/Contact form ownership, scoped chrome and eight hub compositions are live. Exactly 40 page-locale entries were applied and verified; production passed 8/8 hub smoke, 54/54 responsive checks, Plan/Contact one-form contracts, SEO/security probes and tenant isolation.

US-047.proofStatusNote: Merged and production-released on 2026-07-24 at application release commit 0cc90d9276c5256e572af37ba223bfa357ae4b15; later documentation-only master commits do not change the active runtime. PostgreSQL migration and restore-drilled encrypted backup passed. The idempotent production import created 24 Media records and five localized blocks with 120 placements (105 verified, 15 needs-review); repeated apply wrote zero rows. Public desktop/mobile QA exposes exactly 21 verified awards per locale, all 21 images return HTTP 200, and next/previous navigation passes. The unauthenticated Page API still exposes metadata for the three needs-review items; suppression is renderer-only and API hardening is a tracked follow-up. Production API/schema proof confirms 24 governed rows per locale; authenticated production Admin visual QA remains an explicit operator follow-up.

US-048.proofStatusNote: Implemented and production-accepted in WP5 on 2026-07-23. The eight-page hi-fi parity and DOM marker contract are live on wingside.vn. Go-live completed 91/91 with pass_with_notes, responsive audit passed 54/54 with zero failures, Plan/Contact each have one form and no duplicate IDs, and canonical/robots/sitemap/security/tenant probes pass. Remaining decorative alt and disabled lead-delivery notes are non-blocking for this UI story.
